paragraphs.source_en: With Motoyasu at their head, the men advanced toward Okazaki Castle through the afterglow of sunset, marveling all the while at what seemed almost beyond belief. When they reached the castle gate, some were trembling all over with tension. Motoyasu dismounted before the gate and handed the reins to Honda Heihachirō.

units.source_en: With Motoyasu at their head, the men advanced toward Okazaki Castle through the afterglow of sunset, marveling all the while at what seemed almost beyond belief.
units.source_zh: 元康打头，众人沐浴着落日的余晖，一边发出不可思议的感慨，一边向冈崎城进发。

units.source_en: When they reached the castle gate, some were trembling all over with tension.
units.source_zh: 抵达城门时，有人甚至紧张得浑身颤抖。

units.source_en: Motoyasu dismounted before the gate and handed the reins to Honda Heihachirō.
units.source_zh: 元康在城门前下了马，将缰绳递给本多平八郎。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康打头，众人沐浴着落日的余晖，一边发出不可思议的感慨，一边向冈崎城进发。抵达城门时，有人甚至紧张得浑身颤抖。元康在城门前下了马，将缰绳递给本多平八郎。

paragraphs.source_en: The gate, roughly eight ken and four shaku high and two ken and four shaku wide, could withstand no further ravages of war. Through this gate his mother Odai had entered the Matsudaira family as a bride, and through this same gate Motoyasu had been sent away as a hostage.

units.source_en: The gate, roughly eight ken and four shaku high and two ken and four shaku wide, could withstand no further ravages of war.

ja.t: えられそうになかった。

units.source_zh: 这座高约八间四尺、宽约二间四尺的城门再也经不起战争的摧残了。

units.source_en: Through this gate his mother Odai had entered the Matsudaira family as a bride, and through this same gate Motoyasu had been sent away as a hostage.
units.source_zh: 母亲於大从这座城门嫁入松平家，元康也从这座城门被送出去做人质。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这座高约八间四尺、宽约二间四尺的城门再也经不起战争的摧残了。母亲於大从这座城门嫁入松平家，元康也从这座城门被送出去做人质。

paragraphs.source_en: Gazing upward from beneath the gate, he heard the wind in the pines of the Hachiman enclosure; like the voices of distant souls, it seemed to make the very earth tremble.

units.source_en: Gazing upward from beneath the gate, he heard the wind in the pines of the Hachiman enclosure; like the voices of distant souls, it seemed to make the very earth tremble.
units.source_zh: 从城门下向上望去，耳中听着八幡苑的松风，如同遥远的灵魂之音，令大地震动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从城门下向上望去，耳中听着八幡苑的松风，如同遥远的灵魂之音，令大地震动。

paragraphs.source_en: Both arrow towers and all four gun emplacements had fallen into ruin. To the warriors from Sunpu who had been left to guard it, Okazaki Castle was not their home, so naturally they had felt no need to care for it. Wild grass covered the stone walls, four ken and five shaku high, while birds’ nests crowded the eaves of the second gate. Motoyasu gazed at the scene for a long while, then stepped through the gate. He felt that if he lingered any longer, he would be unable to keep from weeping before them all.

units.source_en: Both arrow towers and all four gun emplacements had fallen into ruin.
units.source_zh: 两处箭台和四处炮台均已荒废破败。

units.source_en: To the warriors from Sunpu who had been left to guard it, Okazaki Castle was not their home, so naturally they had felt no need to care for it.
units.source_zh: 在骏府的留守武将看来，冈崎城既然不是他们的家，也理所当然不用加以爱护。

units.source_en: Wild grass covered the stone walls, four ken and five shaku high, while birds’ nests crowded the eaves of the second gate.
units.source_zh: 四间五尺高的石墙上长满野草，二道门的屋檐上则堆满鸟窝。

units.source_en: Motoyasu gazed at the scene for a long while, then stepped through the gate.
units.source_zh: 元康久久地凝视着眼前的一切，抬脚进了城门。

units.source_en: He felt that if he lingered any longer, he would be unable to keep from weeping before them all.

ja.t: をこらえきれなくなると

units.source_zh: 他觉得再待下去，会忍不住在众人面前落泪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 两处箭台和四处炮台均已荒废破败。在骏府的留守武将看来，冈崎城既然不是他们的家，也理所当然不用加以爱护。四间五尺高的石墙上长满野草，二道门的屋檐上则堆满鸟窝。元康久久地凝视着眼前的一切，抬脚进了城门。他觉得再待下去，会忍不住在众人面前落泪。

paragraphs.source_en: There was indeed no sign of a soldier within the castle; all was silent. At the Hachiman enclosure and around the Jizō shrine before the second bailey remained traces of the Sunpu forces’ panicked retreat.

units.source_en: There was indeed no sign of a soldier within the castle; all was silent.
units.source_zh: 城内的确没有士兵的踪影，到处静悄悄的。

units.source_en: At the Hachiman enclosure and around the Jizō shrine before the second bailey remained traces of the Sunpu forces’ panicked retreat.
units.source_zh: 八幡苑和二道城前的地藏神龛处，残留着骏府军撤退时慌乱不堪的痕迹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 城内的确没有士兵的踪影，到处静悄悄的。八幡苑和二道城前的地藏神龛处，残留着骏府军撤退时慌乱不堪的痕迹。

paragraphs.source_en: As he passed the Hachiman enclosure, the second bailey, the enclosure of the family chapel, and the third bailey, the face of his grandfather Kiyoyasu, who had built this castle, seemed to rise clearly before Motoyasu’s eyes. Though his grandfather had fallen in battle at only twenty-five, he had left behind a castle such as this.

units.source_en: As he passed the Hachiman enclosure, the second bailey, the enclosure of the family chapel, and the third bailey, the face of his grandfather Kiyoyasu, who had built this castle, seemed to rise clearly before Motoyasu’s eyes.

ja.t: かんでくるようだった。

units.source_zh: 八幡苑、二道城、持佛堂苑、三道城，一路看去，建造这座城的祖父清康的面孔，似清晰地浮现在元康眼前。

units.source_en: Though his grandfather had fallen in battle at only twenty-five, he had left behind a castle such as this.

ja.t: したというのに、これほどの

units.source_zh: 祖父虽然年仅二十五岁就已战死，却留下了这么一座城池。

paragraphs.source_zh: 八幡苑、二道城、持佛堂苑、三道城，一路看去，建造这座城的祖父清康的面孔，似清晰地浮现在元康眼前。祖父虽然年仅二十五岁就已战死，却留下了这么一座城池。

units.source_en: “Our lord has entered the castle!”
units.source_zh: “主公进城了！”

paragraphs.source_en: When the news reached the women of the Matsudaira clan who had been permitted to live near Okazaki Castle, they erupted in excitement, rejoicing even more than when their husbands and children had returned. The men, however, did not relax their vigilance. Following the old Ōkubo’s instructions, they posted men to guard every gate closely and lit bonfires in the courtyards.

units.source_en: When the news reached the women of the Matsudaira clan who had been permitted to live near Okazaki Castle, they erupted in excitement, rejoicing even more than when their husbands and children had returned.
units.source_zh: 被允居住在冈崎城附近的松平氏的女人们，听到这个消息，顿时沸腾起来，她们甚至比丈夫和孩子归来时更加喜悦。

units.source_en: The men, however, did not relax their vigilance. Following the old Ōkubo’s instructions, they posted men to guard every gate closely and lit bonfires in the courtyards.
units.source_zh: 但男人们却没有放松警惕，按照大久保老人的指示，派人严加把守各处城门，庭院里则燃起了火堆。

paragraphs.source_zh: 被允居住在冈崎城附近的松平氏的女人们，听到这个消息，顿时沸腾起来，她们甚至比丈夫和孩子归来时更加喜悦。但男人们却没有放松警惕，按照大久保老人的指示，派人严加把守各处城门，庭院里则燃起了火堆。

paragraphs.source_en: Even if Tanaka’s troops did not return, should the wandering warriors learn that Okazaki Castle stood empty, they would surely storm it, while night thieves would also descend to plunder amid the turmoil. Lighting the bonfires proclaimed that Matsudaira Kurandonosuke Motoyasu was here; it was the same as raising a banner.

units.source_en: Even if Tanaka’s troops did not return, should the wandering warriors learn that Okazaki Castle stood empty, they would surely storm it, while night thieves would also descend to plunder amid the turmoil.
units.source_zh: 即使田中的军队不返回，但如果野武士知道冈崎城已是一座空城，定会冲杀进来，夜贼也会来趁火打劫。

units.source_en: Lighting the bonfires proclaimed that Matsudaira Kurandonosuke Motoyasu was here; it was the same as raising a banner.
units.source_zh: 燃烧起火堆，就宣布松平藏人佐元康在此，相当于竖起了一面旗帜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 即使田中的军队不返回，但如果野武士知道冈崎城已是一座空城，定会冲杀进来，夜贼也会来趁火打劫。燃烧起火堆，就宣布松平藏人佐元康在此，相当于竖起了一面旗帜。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time the chief retainers had gathered in the great hall for the celebratory feast, it was already the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Dog.

units.source_en: By the time the chief retainers had gathered in the great hall for the celebratory feast, it was already the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Dog.
units.source_zh: 当重臣们纷纷聚集到大厅举行庆祝宴时，已是晚上戌时四刻了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当重臣们纷纷聚集到大厅举行庆祝宴时，已是晚上戌时四刻了。

paragraphs.source_en: “The mountain wolf has wept.” It was Ishikawa Aki who spoke.

units.source_en: “The mountain wolf has wept.”
units.source_zh: “山中的野狼哭了。”

units.source_en: It was Ishikawa Aki who spoke.
units.source_zh: 石川安艺道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “山中的野狼哭了。”石川安艺道。

paragraphs.source_en: “I am not weeping. I am laughing.” The old man burst into laughter as he spoke, then, as though something had suddenly occurred to him, drained the sake in his cup. “This is the song a mountain wolf sings in triumph. All of you, raise your cups and celebrate!”

units.source_en: “I am not weeping. I am laughing.”
units.source_zh: “我不是哭，我是在笑。”

units.source_en: The old man burst into laughter as he spoke, then, as though something had suddenly occurred to him, drained the sake in his cup.
units.source_zh: 老人一边说一边大笑，忽然像想起什么，将杯中的酒一饮而尽。

units.source_en: “This is the song a mountain wolf sings in triumph.
units.source_zh: “这是山中的野狼得意时的歌声。

units.source_en: All of you, raise your cups and celebrate!”
units.source_zh: 你们也都举杯道贺吧！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我不是哭，我是在笑。”老人一边说一边大笑，忽然像想起什么，将杯中的酒一饮而尽。“这是山中的野狼得意时的歌声。你们也都举杯道贺吧！”

paragraphs.source_en: The Matsudaira men were all masters of the battlefield, but knew little of song and dance, and so they merely watched in silence.

units.source_en: The Matsudaira men were all masters of the battlefield, but knew little of song and dance, and so they merely watched in silence.
units.source_zh: 松平人都是战场好手，对歌舞却不在行，只是静静地观看。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松平人都是战场好手，对歌舞却不在行，只是静静地观看。

paragraphs.source_en: “When we have been treated to such rare song and dance, how can we not applaud and offer our congratulations?” Even after Uemura Shinrokurō had returned to his seat, Nagasaka Chiyari Kurō, seated at the very end, was still clapping his hands. “Splendid! Though I do not understand its deeper meaning, it is splendid indeed!”

units.source_en: “When we have been treated to such rare song and dance, how can we not applaud and offer our congratulations?”
units.source_zh: “难得有此歌舞助兴，我们怎能不拍手称贺呢？”

units.source_en: Even after Uemura Shinrokurō had returned to his seat, Nagasaka Chiyari Kurō, seated at the very end, was still clapping his hands.
units.source_zh: 植村新六郎归座后，末座的长坂血枪九郎还在抚掌。

units.source_en: “Splendid!
units.source_zh: “有意思。

units.source_en: Though I do not understand its deeper meaning, it is splendid indeed!”
units.source_zh: 我虽不懂得其中深意，有意思呀！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “难得有此歌舞助兴，我们怎能不拍手称贺呢？”植村新六郎归座后，末座的长坂血枪九郎还在抚掌。“有意思。我虽不懂得其中深意，有意思呀！”

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu could not help turning his face away. As he listened to Gagakunosuke speak those unforgettable names, the full meaning of all that lay before him began to sink in anew. This was his own castle! From this day forward, he must strive with all his might! He was the pillar supporting all these retainers who stood by him!

units.source_en: Motoyasu could not help turning his face away.
units.source_zh: 元康忍不住背过脸去。

units.source_en: As he listened to Gagakunosuke speak those unforgettable names, the full meaning of all that lay before him began to sink in anew.
units.source_zh: 听着雅乐助口中那些令人难以忘怀的人名，他也开始重新体会眼前的一切。

units.source_en: This was his own castle!
units.source_zh: 这是自己的城池！

units.source_en: From this day forward, he must strive with all his might!
units.source_zh: 从今以后必须发奋图强！

units.source_en: He was the pillar supporting all these retainers who stood by him!
units.source_zh: 我是这些支持我的家臣们的支柱啊！

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康忍不住背过脸去。听着雅乐助口中那些令人难以忘怀的人名，他也开始重新体会眼前的一切。这是自己的城池！从今以后必须发奋图强！我是这些支持我的家臣们的支柱啊！
